description: New ADGM entity of Bank of Palestine (Palestine's largest bank), which received an FSRA in-principle approval (IPA) on 29-Dec-2025 for a Category 1 (full banking) licence — the highest FSRA banking category, requiring USD 10m capital. Authorised activities on the IPA: accepting deposits and arranging deals in investments, targeting the global Palestinian diaspora with digital-first banking. Expected fully operational H2 2026. Bank of Palestine has held a DIFC representative office in Dubai since 2015 and recently opened a Cairo rep office; this ADGM entity is a genuine new, separately licensed operating bank, not a rep office. Linda Tarazi appointed CEO of the ADGM entity.

fit.reasoning: Fit 40/60: priority segment bank (20) + priority market UAE (15) + regulated by a named regulator (5). Multi-asset and third-party-money rows withheld (0/20 combined) — the public IPA describes deposit-taking and investment dealing for a digital-first diaspora bank, not confirmed multi-asset portfolio/fund management, so credit is conservative pending more detail on what the ADGM entity will actually book. Timing 20/25: a hard new-licence trigger (IPA 29-Dec-2025, going operational H2 2026) with no incumbent system in the new entity by definition — the best kind of timing signal. Access 8/15: named CEO identified (Linda Tarazi) via multiple press sources, but no LinkedIn profile or contact detail could be confirmed/verified in this research, so treat as a named-but-not-yet-reachable decision-maker. Total 68 rounds to 66 — strong queue candidate; re-check status close to the H2 2026 go-live, since a bank standing up new infrastructure pre-launch is exactly when a PMS/core decision gets made.
